text: paññāyissati ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyissati . yā vedanā . yā saññā . ye saṅkhārā . yaṃ viññāṇaṃ ajātaṃ apātubhūtaṃ tassa uppādo paññāyissati vayo paññāyissati ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyissati . imesaṃ kho ānanda dhammānaṃ uppādo paññāyissati vayo paññāyissati ṭhitānaṃ aññathattaṃ paññāyissati . yaṃ kho ānanda rūpaṃ jātaṃ pātubhūtaṃ tassa uppādo paññāyati vayo paññāyati ṭhitassa aññathattaṃ paññāyati . yā vedanā jātā pātubhūtā .
